translation: That is why MeRA25 insists that the Break with this entire vicious circle of memorandum policies and oligarchy is the only answer to the multiple crisis.

title: ΜέΡΑ25 app
summary: MeRA25 argues that removing Prime Minister Mitsotakis is insufficient and calls for a fundamental break with austerity policies and oligarchy, criticizing continuation of energy market policies, foreclosures, hydrocarbon extraction, military spending, and privatization of public spaces.

translation: Unfortunately, it is no longer enough for Mitsotakis to leave. If these policies do not change radically, the satisfaction will only be partial and will quickly be swallowed by the harsh reality we are experiencing.

title: Tino Chrupalla: SPD-Chef Klingbeil beim Verbreiten von Fake-News ertappt - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla accused SPD chairman Klingbeil of spreading fake news about New Year's Eve incidents to distract from Berlin riots, claiming attacks on security forces are mostly committed by migrants and demanding prosecution and deportation.
speaker: Tino Chrupalla
original_quote: SPD-Chef Klingbeil hat Fake-News verbreitet, um von den Silvester-Krawallen in Berlin abzulenken. Dass er sich nun dafür entschuldigt, ist ehrenwert, reicht aber nicht aus. Er muss auch die Konsequenzen aus der realen Sicherheitslage ziehen. Angriffe auf Einsatzkräfte gehen größtenteils von Migranten aus. Dagegen hilft nur konsequente Strafverfolgung mitsamt Abschiebung der verurteilten Angreifer.
translation: SPD chairman Klingbeil has spread fake news to distract from the New Year's Eve riots in Berlin. That he is now apologizing for it is honorable, but not sufficient. He must also draw consequences from the real security situation. Attacks on security forces are mostly committed by migrants. Only consistent prosecution together with deportation of convicted attackers will help against this.

title: Alice Weidel: Migrationsbericht ist unüberhörbares Alarmzeichen für den Sozialstaat - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel criticizes the government's migration report, claiming that 2021 saw 500,000 non-EU migrants with only 40,000 receiving work permits while asylum applications rose 45%, and calls for closed borders and an end to fast-track naturalization.
speaker: Alice Weidel
original_quote: Der Migrationsbericht zeigt auf, dass die Warnungen vor einer Einwanderung in den Sozialstaat statt in den Arbeitsmarkt mehr als berechtigt sind. Von den rund 500.000 Migranten, die 2021 aus Nicht-EU-Ländern einwanderten, erhielten nur 40.000 einen Aufenthaltstitel zur Erwerbstätigkeit.
translation: The migration report shows that warnings about immigration into the welfare state instead of the labor market are more than justified. Of the approximately 500,000 migrants who immigrated from non-EU countries in 2021, only 40,000 received a residence permit for employment.

title: Alice Weidel: Migrationsbericht ist unüberhörbares Alarmzeichen für den Sozialstaat - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD federal spokesperson Alice Weidel criticizes the government's migration report, claiming that 2021 saw 500,000 non-EU migrants with only 40,000 receiving work permits while asylum applications rose 45%, and calls for closed borders and an end to fast-track naturalization.
speaker: Alice Weidel
original_quote: Statt Blitzeinbürgerungen braucht unser Land eine Politik der geschlossenen Grenzen, die sich zuerst dem Wohl der eigenen Bürger widmet und nach außen hin verdeutlicht, dass sich eine Einreise in unser Land nicht mehr lohnt.
translation: Instead of fast-track naturalizations, our country needs a policy of closed borders that is primarily dedicated to the welfare of its own citizens and makes it clear to the outside world that entering our country is no longer worthwhile.

title: Stephan Brandner: Wer Molotow-Cocktails auf Polizisten wirft, ist kein Aktivist sondern ein Terrorist - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner condemned violence against police during the Lützerath eviction, calling those throwing Molotov cocktails terrorists rather than activists and criticizing what he termed a lenient approach to left-green extremists.
speaker: Stephan Brandner
original_quote: Der Kuschelkurs mit links-grünen Terroristen muss ein Ende haben. Hier stehen Menschenleben auf dem Spiel.
translation: The coddling course with left-green terrorists must come to an end. Human lives are at stake here.

title: Stephan Brandner: Wer Molotow-Cocktails auf Polizisten wirft, ist kein Aktivist sondern ein Terrorist - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner condemned violence against police during the Lützerath eviction, calling those throwing Molotov cocktails terrorists rather than activists and criticizing what he termed a lenient approach to left-green extremists.
speaker: Stephan Brandner
original_quote: Die Gewalteskalation zeigt einmal mehr, dass es nicht um den Schutz von Umwelt und Klima geht, sondern um eine Ablehnung des Systems.
translation: The escalation of violence shows once again that this is not about protecting the environment and climate, but about a rejection of the system.

title: Tino Chrupalla: EU lässt Gelegenheit für mehr strategische Autonomie verstreichen - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD federal spokesman Tino Chrupalla criticized the EU-NATO joint declaration, arguing that the EU missed an opportunity for greater strategic autonomy and remains subordinate to the USA, warning against escalation of economic conflict between West and East into bloc confrontation.
speaker: Tino Chrupalla
original_quote: Die Europäische Union hat heute eine Gelegenheit für mehr strategische Autonomie verstreichen lassen. Europa bleibt vorerst der kleine Bruder der USA. Wir müssen dafür sorgen, dass der Wirtschaftskrieg zwischen Westen und Osten nicht zu einer neuen Blockkonfrontation ausgeweitet wird. Sonst geraten Sicherheit und Wohlstand auf dem Kontinent Europa in Gefahr.
translation: The European Union has today let an opportunity for greater strategic autonomy pass. Europe remains for now the little brother of the USA. We must ensure that the economic war between West and East is not expanded into a new bloc confrontation. Otherwise security and prosperity on the European continent are in danger.

title: Stephan Brandner: Qualität statt Parität! - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner criticizes the Thuringian Green Party's dismissal of Justice and Migration Minister Dirk Adams to fulfill gender quotas, arguing that qualifications rather than quotas should determine ministerial appointments.
speaker: Stephan Brandner
original_quote: Zu keinem Zeitpunkt war bei den Grünen zu hören, dass der Minister für Justiz Jurist sein sollte, was weder Adams noch Denstädt erfüllen.
translation: At no point was it heard from the Greens that the Minister for Justice should be a lawyer, which neither Adams nor Denstädt fulfill.

title: Stephan Brandner: Qualität statt Parität! - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Stephan Brandner criticizes the Thuringian Green Party's dismissal of Justice and Migration Minister Dirk Adams to fulfill gender quotas, arguing that qualifications rather than quotas should determine ministerial appointments.
speaker: Stephan Brandner
original_quote: Für uns als AfD spielen willkürliche Quoten keine Rolle: einzig die Qualifikation für ein Amt ist Bedingung zur Übernahme der Verantwortung.
translation: For us as AfD, arbitrary quotas play no role: only the qualification for an office is a condition for assuming responsibility.

title: Mariana Harder-Kühnel: Ampel forciert Blitzeinbürgerungen: Deutschland schafft sich ab! - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Mariana Harder-Kühnel criticizes the German government's planned citizenship law reform that would allow naturalization after three years in certain cases, calling it "flash naturalizations" and demanding closed borders and a "remigration offensive" instead.
speaker: Mariana Harder-Kühnel
original_quote: Nicht nur aus Silvester hat die Ampelkoalition nichts gelernt. Ungeachtet der gravierenden Folgen der unkontrollierten Migration der vergangenen Jahre hält das Kabinett Scholz auch weiterhin daran fest, die Hürden für eine Einbürgerung deutlich abzusenken.
translation: The traffic light coalition has learned nothing from New Year's Eve. Despite the serious consequences of uncontrolled migration in recent years, the Scholz cabinet continues to insist on significantly lowering the hurdles for naturalization.

title: Mariana Harder-Kühnel: Ampel forciert Blitzeinbürgerungen: Deutschland schafft sich ab! - Alternative für Deutschland
summary: AfD deputy federal spokesperson Mariana Harder-Kühnel criticizes the German government's planned citizenship law reform that would allow naturalization after three years in certain cases, calling it "flash naturalizations" and demanding closed borders and a "remigration offensive" instead.
speaker: Mariana Harder-Kühnel
original_quote: Als AfD stellen wir uns deshalb nicht nur entschieden gegen jede Aufweichung der Einbürgerungspolitik, sondern fordern im Gegenteil eine Remigrationsoffensive. Die Grenzen müssen geschlossen und zügige Rückführungen all jener in Angriff genommen werden, die ausreisepflichtig sind.
translation: As AfD, we therefore not only firmly oppose any softening of naturalization policy, but on the contrary demand a remigration offensive. The borders must be closed and swift deportations of all those who are obliged to leave must be undertaken.

title: Illegale migratie in EU op hoogste niveau sinds 2016: “Opvang moet per definitie in eigen regio”
summary: Vlaams Belang MEP Tom Vandendriessche responds to Frontex data showing 330,000 illegal border crossings in 2022 by calling for reception in migrants' own regions, loss of asylum rights for illegal entrants, and rejection of the EU Migration Pact.
speaker: Tom Vandendriessche
original_quote: Opvang moet per definitie in eigen regio gebeuren. Ontwikkelingshulp moet afhankelijk gemaakt worden van terugname van illegalen. De buitengrenzen moet juridisch en fysiek waterdicht worden gemaakt. Wie illegaal Europa binnenkomt, moet elk recht op asiel verliezen. NGO's die meewerken aan illegale migratie zijn criminele organisaties.
translation: Reception must by definition take place in one's own region. Development aid must be made dependent on the return of illegals. The external borders must be made legally and physically watertight. Whoever enters Europe illegally must lose every right to asylum. NGOs that cooperate with illegal migration are criminal organizations.

speaker: Dominiek Lootens-Stael
original_quote: Brandweermannen getuigen vaak van aanvallen door niet-Europese vreemdelingen, blijkbaar uit onbegrip tegenover medische en andere noodprocedures.
translation: Firefighters often testify to attacks by non-European foreigners, apparently due to incomprehension towards medical and other emergency procedures.

title: “Vlaams Belang steunt vakbondsprotest Brusselse hulpverleners”

original_quote: Het gaat hier echt over een structureel probleem dat voortvloeit uit een totaal gebrek aan integratie

title: “Geen voorwaardelijke vrijheid voor IS-gangsters”
summary: Vlaams Belang criticizes the Belgian government for conditionally releasing an IS terrorist who was later arrested in Hungary attempting to travel to Syria, demanding that IS members be prosecuted in the region where they committed crimes rather than repatriated.
actors: Barbara Pas; Vincent Van Quickenborne; Alexander De Croo
speaker: Barbara Pas
original_quote: Ze was, hoe kan het ook anders, in België vrijgelaten onder voorwaarden
translation: She was, how could it be otherwise, released in Belgium under conditions

title: “Geen voorwaardelijke vrijheid voor IS-gangsters”
summary: Vlaams Belang criticizes the Belgian government for conditionally releasing an IS terrorist who was later arrested in Hungary attempting to travel to Syria, demanding that IS members be prosecuted in the region where they committed crimes rather than repatriated.
actors: Barbara Pas; Vincent Van Quickenborne; Alexander De Croo
speaker: Barbara Pas
original_quote: Het getuigt van een nauwelijks te vatten naïviteit om te denken dat wie onze vrije Westerse samenleving zo diep haat, eenvoudig tot inkeer zou kunnen komen en klaar zou zijn voor een voorwaardelijke vrijlating.
translation: It shows a barely comprehensible naivety to think that those who hate our free Western society so deeply could simply repent and be ready for conditional release.

title: “Geen voorwaardelijke vrijheid voor IS-gangsters”
summary: Vlaams Belang criticizes the Belgian government for conditionally releasing an IS terrorist who was later arrested in Hungary attempting to travel to Syria, demanding that IS members be prosecuted in the region where they committed crimes rather than repatriated.
actors: Barbara Pas; Vincent Van Quickenborne; Alexander De Croo
speaker: Barbara Pas
original_quote: Het standpunt van het Vlaams Belang is in deze zeer duidelijk: IS-gangsters moeten berecht en bestraft worden in de regio waar ze zich aan hun gruwelijkheden hebben schuldig gemaakt
translation: The position of Vlaams Belang is very clear on this: IS gangsters must be tried and punished in the region where they committed their atrocities

title: “Weer een slachtoffer van de straffeloosheid”

original_quote: De overbevolking in de gevangenissen oplossen doe je niet door onveiligheid op straat te creëren, maar door veroordeelden hun straffen te laten uitzitten in hun land van herkomst.
